claim_text: Luckin operated 4,500+ retail stores in China by Q3 2019, growing rapidly
Average store-level same-store sales of ~RMB 4-5/cup with growing transaction volume per store
Luckin's auditor (Marcum BP / Ernst & Young) issued clean audit opinions
Luckin's pre-IPO institutional backers (BlackRock, Singapore GIC, Centurium) demonstrate validation
F-1 prospectus presents store growth and revenue figures consistently with subsequent 6-K disclosures
